# KBMH - Kettlebell Workouts App

> > KBMH is a kettlebell workout app featuring 300+ free EMOM, AMRAP, HIIT, and Tabata workouts with follow-along videos, created by Vadim Firsov for time-efficient training.

The app integrates with HealthKit, Google Health, Apple Watch, Garmin Connect, WHOOP, Strava, and other fitness platforms. It offers structured programs, exercise demos, and specialized workout timers for busy people seeking minimal-equipment training solutions.

## Key Topics

- KBMH app
- Kettlebell workouts
- EMOM (Every Minute On the Minute)
- AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible)
- HIIT training
- Tabata intervals

- [Free Workout Timer App by KBMH](https://kbmh.app/workout-timer-app): All-in-one timer for EMOM, HIIT, Tabata, and AMRAP workouts
- [AMRAP Timer App by KBMH](https://kbmh.app/workout-timer-app/amrap): Free AMRAP timer for CrossFit and kettlebell circuit workouts
